steps.result: Add a date range picker to trip search

steps.text:
Done. The picker is in https://github.com/trailhead/web/pull/488, and the API side already shipped in https://github.com/trailhead/api/pull/241.

- Fixes https://github.com/trailhead/web/issues/471
- The end date is now kept by [`parseRange`](https://github.com/trailhead/web/blob/main/src/lib/dates.ts#L10-L16), which used to drop it.
